```yaml
name: Codex Review - Notify Code Owner

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]
    types: [ opened, synchronize, reopened ]

jobs:
  notify-code-owner:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: useblacksmith/setup-node@v5
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run TypeScript Future Audit
        run: |
          npm run tsconfig:future-audit
        continue-on-error: true

      - name: Check for TypeScript config changes
        id: check_ts_changes
        run: |
          git diff --name-only HEAD~1 HEAD | grep -E "(tsconfig|tooling/typescript-config)" > /dev/null && echo "ts_changes=true" >> $GITHUB_ENV || echo "ts_changes=false" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Notify code owner for TypeScript changes
        if: env.ts_changes == 'true'
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          script: |
            const { data: pr } = await github.rest.pulls.get({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              pull_number: context.issue.number
            });

            const codeOwner = pr.author_association === 'OWNER' ? pr.user.login : 'core-team';

            await github.rest.issues.createComment({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              issue_number: context.issue.number,
              body: `@${codeOwner} Please review the TypeScript configuration changes in this PR. This includes updates to base.tsconfig and removal of redundant baseUrl entries.`
            });
```
